name: Johnson Controls
description: Johnson Controls designs, makes, installs and services the equipment that runs commercial buildings: HVAC and chillers (YORK), building controls (Metasys), fire detection and suppression (Simplex, Grinnell, Ansul), security systems and industrial refrigeration (Frick, Sabroe). It sells through its own sales and service offices plus distributors, and about 32 percent of sales are services (maintenance, repair, retrofit) that recur on the installed base, with the OpenBlue software platform layered on top. Since the July 2025 sale of its residential and light commercial HVAC business to Bosch it is a pure commercial-buildings company reporting by region: Americas, EMEA and APAC. Backlog of $21.0 billion at 2026-06-30 was up 32 percent on a year earlier, helped by data-centre projects.

sub.name: Heating, cooling, elevators, lighting and building controls

employees.note: About 87,000 people worldwide (31,000 in the US, 56,000 outside); down from 2024 mainly because of divestitures including the residential HVAC business. About 21 percent covered by collective bargaining or works councils.

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: Sells and installs commercial HVAC, controls, fire, security and refrigeration systems under project contracts (backlog converts to revenue as jobs are installed), plus recurring service and maintenance contracts on the installed base; includes data-centre cooling.

businessLines.name: EMEA
businessLines.how: Same commercial-building systems and services model in Europe, Middle East and Africa, plus a residential security subscriber business and marine customers; mix shifting to services.

businessLines.name: APAC
businessLines.how: Commercial-building systems and services in Asia Pacific, sold through project contracts and service work.

brands.name: YORK, Metasys, Ansul, Frick, FM:Systems, PENN, Sabroe, Silent-Aire, Simplex, Grinnell
brands.note: Named in the 10-K as its key building brands; revenue by brand not disclosed

brands.name: OpenBlue
brands.note: Digital software platform (remote diagnostics, predictive maintenance, workplace management); revenue not broken out

brands.name: Residential and Light Commercial HVAC (sold)
brands.note: Sold to Robert Bosch GmbH on 2025-07-31 including the North America ducted business and the Hitachi residential joint venture; net cash proceeds about $5.6 billion, returned through a $5.0 billion accelerated share repurchase.
